title: Click pen
object: Retractable ballpoint pen in longitudinal section
idea: A toggle (finite state machine) built from geometry
summary: A push-push cam as a state machine. Each press drives the rotator's lugs below the guide's ridge teeth and the plunger tooth turns them 30°; on release the ridge tooth turns them another 30°, into a long slot (retracted) or a short slot (extended), alternately. The developed cam track shows the lug's path, and the section shows the lug change sides with every click.
usedFor: Product design teaching: cams, indexing and snap-fit mechanisms
Software-concept explainer: a toggle or T flip-flop as a finite state machine
Product documentation for retractable pens and push-push latches
controls: Drag the button in · Space clicks · ← → press and release · S slow motion
controls3d: Drag to orbit · opens with the cam stack drawn apart: drag the button in, Space or ← → closes it up and clicks · E explode (the rotator slides out along the long slots) · C cut · 1–4 views · S slow motion
